summary: Cedar Grove Marina: operator campsites page (modified 2026-03-27), home page, Storable rental engine, Google, gateways, Esri/3DEP read. $50 first night / $45 each consecutive night / $275 a week - passes the $50 gate; 30/50 A with water; dump; 115+ sites; online booking on the marina's own engine (FareHarbor link dead). Yearly rentals with a waitlist; nightly share unmeasured.
flags: PRICE GATE: pass at the gate line - $50 for a single night, $45 each consecutive night, $275 a week (operator page modified 2026-03-27). No Good Sam status; no gateway within 40 km (GSMNP 77 km). Google 4.2 (214).

LONG-STAY: the operator offers yearly rentals ('Our yearly rental spots book well in advance ... joining our waitlist') beside nightly/weekly ('We offer nightly and weekly reservations based on availability'). Imagery shows a dense block of RVs with decks and sheds, which reads as mostly yearly sites. Nightly share could not be measured: the Storable engine shows only two generic 'Campsites' units (30 A / 50 A) without a site list. Test 2 passes (posted nightly rate), test 5 not failed (no lots sold). Read as possibly mostly seasonal, not borderline-iffy (posted rate, booking engine, 214 Google reviews). Reviewer may want the nightly share by phone.

WATERFRONT LEAD (stored not waterfront, not changed): the operator says 'Our clean campsites are located right next to Norris Lake and offer views of the lake'; a quoted review: 'It was so nice being able to go just a few steps to put our yaks in the water.' 3DEP puts the east loop (~36.36565,-83.71489) at 313.1 m, ~2.2 m above the ~310.9 m summer pool line ~30-45 m east over a gentle slope; ground between is brushy on the winter imagery. No site numbers or per-site tags published, so no upgrade; a lakeview or lakefront call needs a site map.

BOOKING LINK: the site's 'Reservations' link (fareharbor.com/embeds/book/cedargrovemarinatn/...) is dead (FareHarbor 'Page not found'); the working engine is rentals.cedargrovemarinatn.com (Storable Rentals).

Hookups: sewer not written - the rental engine says 'Sewer on site', the operator lists only 'Dump Station Access' for nightly sites and says sewer comes with yearly rentals; a quoted guest review says 'it would be great if you were equipped with sewer hookups'.
PHONE 865-278-3131 kept; website kept. Address on the operator page is '255 Dock Lane' (Google: 255 Dock Rd).
